1.overview: Sakamoto is a stylish student whose cool behavior draws the attention of everyone at his high school. Three punks in his class who don't like him, Acchan, Mario, and Kenken, target him for all sorts of bullying, but it always backfires on them. So they finally decide to take care of him for real...

One day, Sakamoto sees his classmate, Kubota, being shaken down for money. He calls out to him, and Kubota begs for his help, saying he has no money left. But Sakamoto has an idea...

Who's the coolest? Sakamoto. Girls compete for him and play Kokkuri-San to find out who he likes. How will it end up?

4.overview: Every day, Sakamoto arrives at the last possible minute and uses all kinds of tricks to slip through the gate in time.  Kakuta-sensei, the guidance counselor, keeps an eye out for Sakamoto at the school gate, but Sakamoto always bests him.  Now he's determined to catch Sakamoto!
4.summary:
Kakuta-sensei, the guidance counselor, keeps an eye out for Sakamoto at the school gate every morning. But every day, Sakamoto arrives at the last possible minute and uses all kinds of tricks to slip through the gate in time, much to Kakuta-sensei`s chagrin. Now he`s determined to find Sakamoto`s weak point and scold him until he can`t even stand up straight...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ソフトボール投げ / カリスマヤンキー8823先輩 / 健康管理
title.en: Softball Throw / The Charismatic Delinquent, Hayabusa-senpai / Personal Health Care

5.overview: Sakamoto has permanently scarred Maruyama from when he was his personal errand boy.  Hayabusa-senpai, the delinquent and head of the second-years, challenges Sakamoto to a fight!
5.summary:
Maruyama still hasn`t recovered from the trauma he experienced when Sakamoto was his personal errand boy. As he watches Maruyama tremble in fear at the mere sight of Sakamoto, Hayabusa-senpai, fellow delinquent and head of the second-years, challenges Sakamoto to fight one-on-one!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 下校のルール / カメラ越しの恋 / 食堂マーケティング

title.x-jat: Gekou no Rule / Camera-goshi no Koi / Shokudou Marketing

6.overview: Sakamoto imparts lessons upon young children playing games each day on their way home from school.  Sakamoto is being followed by a poltergeist!  Can a classmate who follows Sakamoto around with a camera tell him?
6.summary:
Kicking rocks, walking on a white line... Sakamoto makes even looks stylish playing such silly after-school games. Three young boys see him and follow him, undaunted. Despite their initial sense of rivalry, the boys find themselves increasingly drawn to Sakamoto... when suddenly, an obstacle stands in their path!
Source: crunchyroll

7.overview: One day finds Acchan, Kenken, and Mario in the video rental store. They have only one goal: to get into the 18+ section, rent their films of choice, and make the leap into watching porn! But the gate that separates them from the adult realm (the curtain to the 18+ section) is thick, and they can't seem to break through. Just then, Sakamoto strolls into the scene!

Sakamoto has never seen accumulated snow before, so Acchan declares he'll teach him how to play in snow, but Sakamoto easily masters everything Acchan tries to teach him. title.en: Haven`t You Heard? I Was Sakamoto

S1.overview: The students of Class 2-1 reminisce about their time with Sakamoto, contemplate what he might be up to at present time, and wonder where he might be headed.
S1.summary:
Just who is Sakamoto? He`s enigmatic. He`s clever. He`s dashing. No challenge is too great and no cause is too small for Sakamoto. Girls love him, guys hate him for it, and despite efforts to humiliate him, Sakamoto is flawlessly able to emerge from the fray, even cooler than ever. Who knows what Sakamoto is going to do next? Whatever it is, it will be fabulous!
Source: crunchyroll
